prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1073; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened?

A: I was changing lanes on the highway, moving into the right lane because the exit was coming up. I checked my mirror and didn't see anything right beside me. When I started to move over, a pickup clipped the back corner of my car and pushed me toward the shoulder.

Q: Was your turn signal on before you began moving over?

A: Yes, I'd had it on for a few seconds. I'm pretty sure of that.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the contact, or only after?

A: Only after. It seemed like it came up in my blind spot pretty fast. I heard a loud scrape and then felt the steering wheel jerk.

Q: Did you stop at the scene, and were any police called?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed put. An officer came out and took information from both of us.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My right wrist is broken. The doctor said it's a fracture, and I'm wearing a splint and I have a follow-up appointment next week. My neck is sore too, but the wrist is the main thing.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm trying to get my car looked at and I'd appreciate a call back about a rental.

Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
